auditor: analytical-auditor (Sonnet, blind: claim and data paths only; the tool and the result were not read)

round1.defect: the tool reported 262 eligible drives and 'drives without cloud rows: 0': the eligibility step lacked the 10-moving-row floor and tested missing values while the field holds zeros
round1.fix: eligible() now applies the floor (241 eligible drives, matching the auditor); the integrity block carries drives_below_minimum_cloud_rows_or_without (264), the floor and the count of drives with a missing outlier flag; the gate result and every estimate are unchanged
concerns_and_disclosures: 12 drives with a missing ens_outlier_v2 are treated as clean (as in M769 and M770); excluding them gives 237 eligible drives and 6 wet-proxy drives
month fixed effects are nearly collinear with the wet proxy (1 to 3 wet-proxy drives per month; within-month share 0.96)
the first-drive-of-day flag is computed over the whole master; computed within the contrast sample the dark-proxy difference moves from -0.11 to -0.37 (now written by the tool as a sensitivity)
a 0.05 wiper threshold means at least one wiper-on row (about 12 rows per drive); the M729 span rule and the source codes 6 and 7 are not applied or separable (deviation, spec 7.5)
the battery-side wet count of 6 (against 8 eligible) reflects outcome availability

after_round1.a3_draws: rerun at 4000 draws as the standing rule requires: difference -0.114 [-0.833, 0.389], MDE 0.849, 7 of 4000 resamples rank deficient; sensitivity with the first-of-day flag within the sample -0.373 [-1.170, 0.234], MDE 1.002
after_round1.field_rename: contrast_positive_drives replaces the mislabelled wet_drives in the generic contrast output (it counts dark-proxy drives in A3)
